Oracle cut 21,000 full-time jobs, about 13% of its global workforce, during fiscal year 2026.
Global layoffs of up to 30,000 jobs, including roughly 12,000 in India, tied to AI infrastructure spending.
Oracle India workforce reportedly shrinks to 27,000 after cutting about 12,000 India jobs earlier in the year.
Oracle reported US$57 billion in revenue for fiscal year 2025.
Oracle posted quarterly revenue of $17.2 billion, its highest in 15 years, amid debt and capex concerns.
